implementation.admission: The FIELD output profile admits types 16 and 32 only with coordinate variants, group-code base 11, finite components, no flags/units/handle/raw/string metadata, and data size absent or exact (16/24 bytes). A 2D value with a nonzero Z component is refused.
implementation.serialization: The shared DXF CadValue writer emits type and size, then group 11 X, group 21 Y, and group 31 Z only for type 32. The typed FIELD decoder requires ordered coordinate components and publishes readback values.
implementation.scope: Generated AC1027 ASCII and Binary DXF FIELD transport, including main and child cache values. This does not prove physical DWG producer profiles, native FIELD evaluation, or consumer rendering semantics.

sources.finding: writeCadValue emits group 11 for both point types.
readCadValue consumes groups 11, 21, and 31 into coordinate values.

independentImplementationCrossCheck.qualification: Source-level independent implementation evidence only; ACadSharp was not executed against generated output, and it is not a native FIELD evaluator.

fastTest.coverage: ASCII and Binary generated FIELDLIST export/import; exact typed coordinate values in main and child records; invalid non-finite coordinate refusal; destination sentinel preservation; successful retry using the same adapter.

refusalAndRetry.invalidMutation: main-cache 3D Z changed to positive infinity
refusalAndRetry.result: export refused and preserved the existing destination bytes
refusalAndRetry.retry: restored finite Z and re-exported successfully using the same adapter
